transcript: Hello, and thank you for calling the information line for the lifeguard division for the city of Oceanside. Please choose from the following options for our weather and surf report. Water temperature off the offshore buoy is currently reading 72 degrees Fahrenheit. There's a seven mile per hour wind blowing out of the East Northeast. Today's tides include a high of 5.4 at 01:16PM, falling to a low of negative 0.1 at 09:22PM. If you would like further information on the Oceanside LifeCard service, please dial (760) 435-4018. Thank you, and have a safe day. No one is available to take your call. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
